import numpy as np
p = np.array([.027, .158, .339, .305, .133, .038])

decay = np.array([.0124, .0305, .111, .301, 1.14, 3.01])

def pack(fn, p, beta, alpha):
    mean, second = fn(p.copy(), beta, alpha.copy())

    return np.concatenate((np.asarray(mean), np.asarray(second).ravel()))
assert np.allclose(pack(compute_fission_moments, p, .0065, alpha), target)

import numpy as np
p = np.array([.027, .158, .339, .305, .133, .038])
alpha = np.array([.033, .219, .196, .395, .115, .042])

te_s = np.array([1000., 15., 5.])

def pack(fn, t, p, generation_time, beta, source, alpha, decay, rho_s, tc_s, te_s):
